heroCaption: Everything you use. Ready when you are.
sourceNote: Source inventory · not live service status
moduleCaption: Show the sources you need. New plugin manifests are discovered automatically.
moduleHint: Hidden modules are still scanned. Disconnect a source in Settings to pause its scanning and related actions.
noJobsHint: Send an instruction below. Progress and results will appear here.
stopNote: Stopping does not undo changes already made.
readOnly: Browse only · send instructions from this Mac
quickInspect: Review this workspace item and explain its purpose and current configuration:
scanError: Some sources could not be read
localOnly: Agent controls stay on this Mac
archiveNote: Archived. Restore this chat to continue.
restoreHint: If the Codex session was archived elsewhere, restore it here.
chatWelcomeHint: Choose a workspace and send an instruction. Each conversation keeps its own working directory.
fastHint: Fast requests priority processing through Codex. Usage depends on the selected model.
startPageHint: Used when you open LocalDesk. Direct links still open their selected view.
modelUnconfigured: No model configured. Run deno task setup --model MODEL_ID --effort EFFORT after signing in to Codex CLI.
sourceHint: Disconnecting pauses the source scanner and its associated actions. Other configured paths or external commands can still access files.
sourceRetention: Saved chats, results and project history remain local. Reconnect to resume scanning.
sourceJobs: Finish or stop queued/running jobs in Activity before disconnecting.
sourceOffline: Source disconnected. Saved history is retained. Reconnect in Settings to use this source.
sourceFailure: Connection unchanged. The source may still be in use; finish the current operation and try again.
sourceScanError: Connected, but the source is unavailable. Check the configured path and scan error.
sourceRefreshFailed: Connection saved. The view could not refresh; reload to check the current source status.
sourceUnknown: Could not confirm the connection result. Reload to check the saved state before trying again.
sourceOverlap: These sources overlap or cannot be distinguished. Change both connections together.
sourceSafety: Skill management pauses while either source is disconnected because skills may reference both sources.
sourceNeedsBoth: A disconnected source path changed. Both sources are paused until you choose Connect both.
